summary: We created a monitoring system capable of measuring diferent parameters like beats per minute, blood pressure, spO2 etc., based on HTML, PHP, CSS, and SQL. This will help astronauts check their medical symptoms or if there’s any problem with their body, making diagnosis easier without the need to self-diagnose.
